mapper.insert: INSERT INTO freight_charges (id, booking_id, status, base_amount, adjustment_amount, total_amount, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{row.id}, #{row.bookingId}, #{row.status}, #{row.baseAmount}, #{row.adjustmentAmount}, #{row.totalAmount}, #{row.createdAt}, #{row.updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE freight_charges SET booking_id = #{row.bookingId}, status = #{row.status}, base_amount = #{row.baseAmount}, adjustment_amount = #{row.adjustmentAmount}, total_amount = #{row.totalAmount}, updated_at = #{row.updatedAt} WHERE id = #{row.id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, booking_id, status, base_amount, adjustment_amount, total_amount, created_at, updated_at FROM freight_charges WHERE booking_id = #{bookingId} ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC
